onboarding.welcomeBody: Simple Fasting helps you track fasts calmly, privately, and without unnecessary accounts or clutter.

features.timerDescription: Start a fast quickly and keep your elapsed or remaining time visible.
features.offlineDescription: Your active fast, history, goals, and settings stay on this device.
features.privacyDescription: No account, no ads, no behavioral profiling, and no advertising identifiers.
features.accentDescription: Personalize the app with a calm accent color that also appears in widgets.
features.remindersDescription: Optional local notifications can remind you when a goal is reached.

onboarding.agreementAccessibilityLabel: I agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy

onboarding.notificationsBody: Notifications help remind you when your goal is reached.
onboarding.notificationsSettings: You can change this later in Settings.
